name: S2Attention

x.description: input feature map (B, C, H, W)

output.description: output feature map (B, C, H, W)

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def spatial_shift1(x):
    b, w, h, c = x.shape
    out = x.clone()
    out[:, 1:, :, :c//4] = x[:, :w-1, :, :c//4]
    out[:, :w-1, :, c//4:c//2] = x[:, 1:, :, c//4:c//2]
    out[:, :, 1:, c//2:c*3//4] = x[:, :, :h-1, c//2:c*3//4]
    out[:, :, :h-1, 3*c//4:] = x[:, :, 1:, 3*c//4:]
    return out

def spatial_shift2(x):
    b, w, h, c = x.shape
    out = x.clone()
    out[:, :, 1:, :c//4] = x[:, :, :h-1, :c//4]
    out[:, :, :h-1, c//4:c//2] = x[:, :, 1:, c//4:c//2]
    out[:, 1:, :, c//2:c*3//4] = x[:, :w-1, :, c//2:c*3//4]
    out[:, :w-1, :, 3*c//4:] = x[:, 1:, :, 3*c//4:]
    return out

def run(x):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    channels = x.shape[1]
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    if b == 0 or c == 0 or h == 0 or w == 0:
        return x
    mlp1 = nn.Linear(c, 3 * c).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    mlp2 = nn.Linear(c, c).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    mlp3 = nn.Linear(c, c).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    mlp4 = nn.Linear(c, 3 * c).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    x = x.permute(0, 3, 2, 1).contiguous()
    x = mlp1(x)
    x1 = spatial_shift1(x[:, :, :, :c])
    x2 = spatial_shift2(x[:, :, :, c:2*c])
    x3 = x[:, :, :, 2*c:]
    x_all = torch.stack([x1, x2, x3], 1)
    B, k, W, H, C_ = x_all.shape
    x_all = x_all.view(B, k, -1, C_)
    a = x_all.float().mean(dim=(1, 2)).to(x.dtype)
    a = mlp3(a)
    a = F.gelu(a.float()).to(x.dtype)
    a = mlp4(a)
    a = F.softmax(a.float().view(B, 3, C_), dim=1).to(x.dtype)
    a = a.unsqueeze(-2)
    out = (a * x_all).sum(1).view(B, W, H, C_)
    out = mlp2(out)
    out = out.permute(0, 3, 2, 1)
    return out
